title: The Medes
lead: An Indo-European people of northwest Iran. They joined Babylon in destroying Nineveh in 612 BC and were absorbed by Cyrus of Persia about 550 BC. The prophets name them as the coming conquerors of Babylon (Isaiah 13:17; Jeremiah 51:11, 28), and Daniel and Esther speak of the 'law of the Medes and Persians'.
